data.name: M_DiagnosticExportContent
data.value: The standard package contains all redacted logs and runtime information. The extended package also contains a redacted settings snapshot, profile counts, and redacted crash reports. Neither package includes profile or history contents or security credentials.

data.name: M_ImportSettingsContent
data.value: All non-credential settings, including window, startup, theme, draw, and desktop integration settings, will be replaced. A recovery snapshot is created first; import is cancelled if it fails. Passwords, TOTP, USB bindings, and lockout state are not imported.

data.name: M_ImportAllDataContent
data.value: All non-credential data, settings, profiles, history, and resources will be replaced. A full recovery snapshot is created first; import is cancelled if it fails. Unrepresentable v2 history is retained as raw data. Security credentials are not imported.
